name: How long do typical move-in repair projects take?

mainEntity.name: How long do typical move-in repair projects take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of move-in repair projects depends heavily on their complexity and scope. Small repairs like drywall patching or faucet replacement might take a few hours to a day. More involved projects, such as a partial kitchen refresh or addressing multiple electrical issues, could span several days to a week. Major renovations or repairs involving permits and multiple trades can take several weeks. A clear timeline should be discussed and agreed upon with your chosen contractor before work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair times vary from a few hours for minor fixes to several weeks for major projects, depending on complexity and scope.
